For (A=I-TC,\ AX=TB), set (S=B+CX), solve (A^H\Lambda=G), and set (Y=T^H\Lambda). Then:

  • (\bar B=Y), local (\bar T_i=\Lambda_iS_i^H), pair (\bar C_{ij}=Y_iX_j^H).
  • Stream each pair cotangent into TranslationPlan::pullback; its conjugation convention already matches. Accumulate displacement gradients with opposite signs.
  • Accumulate sphere cotangents directly into the existing per-order Matrix2 Mie blocks. No global square cotangent is needed.

Random complex-system finite differences confirmed all three pullbacks within (8\times10^{-11}). Recommended checks: dense equivalence, illumination linearity, translation/scaling invariance, particle permutation, single-sphere limit, and adjoint inner products.

GMRES must verify true residuals after restart/breakdown and for both forward and adjoint solves. A block-Jacobi preconditioner is identity for this operator and adds no benefit.
